fillGeometry.source: portal.footprint-specs/v1 (EMBER_DISTRICT_1_PLOT_30 spec, generalised to any staged-fill plot)
fillGeometry.treatment: honest empty plot — fenced parcel, plain-word plot sign, no building until a record names one

geometryNote: Layout v3 composed geometry (M4.11): every node carries a `geometry` object derived from build/visual/footprint-specs.json by build/visual/layout-v3-build.mjs (deterministic; re-running it changes nothing). Rects and anchors are in the build’s world units (1 grid cell = 10 units, Plaza at the origin, +x east, +z south): footprintRect is where the building stands within its cell (façade 1 unit inside the cell edge on its door side; Market Hall’s stall apron reaches that line), door.anchor is the threshold centre of the spec’s door face (corner entries on diagonal frontages shift the door by whole 2-unit modules where the module grid admits it — Market Hall +2, The College −2; all other doors centred), signAnchor is centred on the same face 2.6 units up. Each edge carries a `street` path: the door-to-door polyline the roads are drawn from (scene/streets.mjs; staged-fill edges get theirs from fillGeometry at runtime by the same code). Grid positions, codes, edges and street seconds are unchanged from v1 — v3 changes geometry only. All of it is Portal staging, like every position in this file: composed presentation over the record’s place codes, never measured Elsewhere geography, and the dressing implies no unrecorded feature (no river, pond, or path the record does not name).
note: Staged street geometry over TRUE Elsewhere location codes. Grid positions and street seconds are Portal presentation (staging), never measured world data. codeStatus 'verified' = the code is attested in ~/workspace/elsewhere/reference/openapi.json (Work enum / place codes) or the household's observed Elsewhere record (~/workspace/elsewhere/*.md); 'staging' = label-style code invented by Portal because no true code is verified for that place. provenanceClass (M2.06): 'feed-evidenced' = the code appears in Tier P feed data (voices places / map civic works); 'record-attested' = attested only in the household's Elsewhere record (~/workspace/elsewhere/PERSONA.md, research/01-elsewhere.md), never in the feed — the two anchor plots (District 3 Plot 18, District 1 Plot 31) are this class and must not be presented as Tier P data; 'staging' = Portal-invented, no verified code. A plot code evidenced in the feed but absent from this file (e.g. EMBER_DISTRICT_1_PLOT_30) gets a deterministic staging position in the app by sorted-code fill (build/app/logic.mjs effectiveLayout) — a placed building without a layout edit, its position staging like every position here. A plot with no evidence anywhere gets no node and no position, in this file or in the app. Version 3 adds the composed geometry described in geometryNote; versions 1–2 pinned the codes and their provenance classes (REC-9).
